source: design-proposal.md rev 2 (sha256 92e22eaa...3889) section 8.2; ratings per verification.md section 7 and game-format-catalog r3 section 8. GAP = no rating exists; it is displayed only as 'GAP: no rating' and any rationale stays in the undisplayed note.

full_restart.rating: C; known cost, geometric for novices. Preset strict-kelme = founder preference, no evidence that it beats the alternatives

restart_at_failed_step_new_numbers.rating: C (inference). Paas 1994 is about studying varied worked examples, not about retrying a step (verification 2026-11-19)

last_checkpoint_plus_worked_step.rating: C (inference); no study compares the restart rules (verification 2026-11-19)

none.note: step retry with feedback only; no study isolates it

full_restart_reshuffle.rating: C as a learning engine (FGV style)

requeue_failed_item.rating: B only with a re-test at a later session; C inside one session. Not successive relearning unless the later re-test is on (F6)

none.rating: evidence against (Rowland 2014: no feedback and success at or below 50% gave g=0.03)

numbers_only.rating: B/C; constraint set comes from the instructor's tables and map

explain_only_no_answer.note: procedural ladders only; evidence against for declarative items (Rowland 2014)

locked_sequential.rating: A for step-level feedback, C for locking itself

fade_from_last_step.rating: B for near transfer, far transfer needs principle prompts; counter-evidence F1 (Miller-Cotto 2021); fade schedule is inference (C)

proportional_gap.rating: A for the direction (Cepeda 2006, 2008), C for the interpolation and the 7-365 day clamp

fixed_intervals.rating: convention, no evidence (1/3/7/21 has no source; claim 4 UNVERIFIABLE)

adaptive_response_based.rating: B for adaptive scheduling in general (Mettler 2016, Lindsey 2014), C for FSRS specifically

on.rating: B/C if informational, C if it gates progress

fifty_fifty_assisted.rating: C (inference); counted as assisted. Crowd and friend lifelines are not built (D2)

on.rating: C (competence satisfaction; learning not measured; Sailer 2017)

off.rating: C; only off is shipped in v1 (local-only product, D3)

ttc_r7_r30_t_c30.rating: C (definition adopted per Addendum 4; Kelme may override)
